entities.summary: Tomo Milicevic (b. 1979-09-03, Sarajevo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sarajevo and United States. Known in the fields of united states, composers & musicians, americas.
